chunks: From him, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Muthanna al-Hannat, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) regarding
the pregnant woman whose husband dies, is she entitled to maintenance (nafaqah)? He said: No.
ai.seo_question: Does a pregnant widow receive maintenance from her deceased husband's estate during her waiting period?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies that a pregnant widow's waiting period (iddah) concludes with childbirth, at which point her right to maintenance (nafaqah) ceases, distinguishing her status from that of a non-pregnant widow. This ruling is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for determining the duration of iddah and the financial obligations of the deceased husband's estate during the interim period.
